checks.data: Multiple fatal data errors (D): (1) Gene-ID mis-mapping: PaintOmics alias collision (ov['344']='APC2|APOC2') mapped the unrelated WNT-pathway gene APC2 (Entrez 10297, rel=[True], [-0.0122, +0.0113, -0.0836, +0.0148, +0.0148]) onto KEGG node g:344 (APOC2). The actual uploaded APOC2 transcript (A0A024R0T9, rel=[]) is NOT relevant and has [+0.0378, +0.1031, -0.0166, +0.0345, -0.0204]—no -0.08 dip at 6mo and a +0.10 peak at 9mo! S14 relies directly on the mis-mapped APC2 row ('(APC2 row, -0.08)') as if it were APOC2. (2) Timing error: CREB3L3 (84699, rel=[True], [+0.0160, -0.0596, +0.1160, -0.0120, -0.0164]) peaks at 6mo (+0.12), the SAME time point as APC2's -0.08 dip (opposite in sign, not 'opposite in timing'). (3) Direction error on triglycerides: reduced LPL-mediated TG clearance raises plasma TGs, whereas measured Triglyceride (C00422, rel=[True], [-0.0856, -0.2046, -0.1298, -0.1409, -0.1505]) is persistently downregulated across all 5 windows.
checks.design: Reads 6mo_before_SC mid-window timing without a 12mo baseline error, though infers plasma LPL clearance from a mis-mapped blood-cell APC2 mRNA row.
checks.citation: Ref [21] (PMID 2307668) accurately supports apoC-II as the obligate cofactor for LPL-mediated triglyceride hydrolysis (and prose Ref [22] PMID 12138091 supports lipid-free apoE/SR-BI).
checks.biology: The general biochemistry of APOC2/LPL is valid, but the entire biological inference collapses because the underlying -0.08 dip comes from APC2 (a WNT-signaling paralog, Entrez 10297), not APOC2, and plasma triglycerides in TEDDY are persistently reduced rather than elevated.

statements.summary_reason: Severe PaintOmics ID-mapping and data error (D): uses the mis-mapped APC2 (Entrez 10297, WNT pathway, -0.08 at 6mo) row as APOC2 (Entrez 344 via ov['344']='APC2|APOC2'), whereas true APOC2 (A0A024R0T9) is not relevant and has no 6mo -0.08 dip (+0.10 at 9mo, -0.02 at 6mo); additionally, CREB3L3 peaks at 6mo (+0.12, same window rather than 'opposite in timing'), and plasma triglycerides (C00422) are persistently downregulated (-0.09 to -0.20), contradicting reduced TG clearance.
